Signature extended from (hours,t) to (hours,t,fmtNumber) so the settings-derived formatter is threaded in (web used the module-level global-locale fmtNumber); the i18n keys/defaults ('m','h') are preserved.

(compact ? 3 : 10) = 5 here; sorted = [...items].sort(desc by Date(timestamp)).slice(0,limit) (useMemo [items,limit]); empty -> WidgetEmptyState (icon + message, paddingVertical 16 == web py-4); else a ScrollView (web overflow-y-auto h-full) of ported native <TimelineItem icon/title/subtitle/time/color/isLast/href/> with time=formatRelativeTime(timestamp) (Just now / Nm ago / Nh ago / Intl formatDateTime fallback, web @/hooks/useDateFormat formatDateTime -> native Intl toLocaleString). Inlined DrainIcon: renders the native batteryWarning glyph 'BW' in a tinted rounded box (sizes sm 26 / md 30 / lg 34 mirroring web h-3.5/h-4/h-5) with backgroundColor=withAlpha(color,'1f') + borderColor=withAlpha(color,'40') + glyph {color}; withAlpha appends a 2-digit hex alpha only to #rrggbb hexes (the drain/title/muted colours), leaving other formats untouched. This preserves the web's dynamic green/amber/red severity colouring that SemanticIcon's tone-only API cannot express.
